prose: At DevDay, OpenAI unveiled ChatGPT Space, a collaborative hub where coworkers, ChatGPT, and the new Dots agents share pages and files. Spaces keep uploaded files and generated content organized for a team; the feature rolls out to Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans on desktop and web first, with mobile later. A companion meetings plugin takes notes, generates summaries with action items, files them into a space, and deletes the captured audio afterward (macOS desktop first). ChatGPT is also coming to Slack and Microsoft Teams.
highlights: ChatGPT Space: a shared hub for coworkers, ChatGPT, and Dots agents
Keeps team files and generated content organized in one place
Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans; desktop and web first, mobile later
Meetings plugin: notes, summaries with action items, auto-filed; audio deleted after
